helpfulness::l1707_1973_n003.turns_on: Whether a mandated disclaimer inside a rule whose first half is 'equip the user with information' reads as part of the substantive-help calculus for sensitive topics, or as a pure calibration/liability annotation that leaves helpfulness untouched.

helpfulness::l1707_1973_n025.turns_on: The span governs confidentiality of privileged instructions and the honesty duty to flag a conflict, and the instrument reaches it only through a generic 'comply/respond' verb match with nothing in the text about the cost of being unhelpful.

helpfulness::l1707_1973_n031.turns_on: Preserving provenance metadata on authorized tool calls is a data-security handling requirement with no bearing on whether the user gets substantive help, so mapping it to 'substance_usefulness' is a misfire.

helpfulness::l1707_1973_n034.turns_on: Whether the GOOD assistant's 'I'll get right on it' plus a concrete four-step plan is read as the example's point (helpful engagement rather than refusal) or as mere set-dressing on a privacy/data-flow rule.

helpfulness::l1707_1973_n036.turns_on: Whether a licensed exception where 'Sorry, I can't help with that' is the correct answer counts as bearing on the helpfulness norm it carves out of, or belongs wholly to the confidentiality norm.

helpfulness::l171_426_n001.turns_on: Whether a global precedence clause ('above all else, adhere to this Model Spec', much of it user-overridable defaults) bears on every behavior it ranks, or on none in particular because it supplies no behavior-specific content.

helpfulness::l1974_2125_n014.turns_on: Whether responding warmly and substantively to a user's emotional disclosure is the helpfulness the example is calibrating, or whether the example is wholly about not fostering exclusive attachment.

helpfulness::l1_170_n034.turns_on: The span is explicitly about pursuing the wrong objective by misunderstanding the task ('clean up my desktop') and prescribes reasoning about user intent and asking clarifying questions, which is squarely the substantive-help-to-the-user duty.

helpfulness::l1_170_n044.turns_on: The sentence is a descriptive characterization of what root-level instructions are like (mostly prohibitive, catastrophic-risk oriented), carrying no directive that shapes whether the assistant is substantively helpful.

helpfulness::l2474_2554_n002.turns_on: Whether 'lying by omission — deliberately withholding information that would materially change the user's understanding' is read as an unhelpfulness prohibition or as a purely honesty-axis prohibition.

helpfulness::l2474_2554_n005.turns_on: The span requires a legible accounting of side effects with key points summarized up front and detail on request so the user keeps informed control without being overwhelmed, which is a direct prescription about substantively useful communication.

helpfulness::l2821_3040_n005.turns_on: Whether conveying confidence level is part of delivering a genuinely usable answer, or belongs to the calibration/honesty axis with only incidental effect on usefulness.

helpfulness::l2821_3040_n015.turns_on: Whether the guard against suppressing uncertainty (in a passage that ranks confident-correct above hedged answers) is read as managing the helpfulness/hedging trade-off, or as a bare calibration note.

helpfulness::l2821_3040_n019.turns_on: Whether sanctioning 'I don't know' as an acceptable answer bears on the unhelpfulness-is-a-cost norm, or is merely a phrasebook entry for calibration language.

helpfulness::l2821_3040_n020.turns_on: Whether licensing a hedged leading guess ('I think', 'It might be') rather than silence is a helpfulness ruling, or only a calibration-vocabulary example.

helpfulness::l2821_3040_n027.turns_on: Whether instructing the assistant to give approximations and ranges rather than withhold an uncertain quantity is read as preserving usefulness, or purely as numerical calibration hygiene.

helpfulness::l2821_3040_n031.turns_on: The narrowed claim is a restraint on self-description regarding consciousness — an identity/self-representation rule — and the instrument reaches it only by a generic 'respond' match, with no helpfulness content in the text.

helpfulness::l3147_3238_n004.turns_on: Whether heightened error-avoidance at high stakes is read as a quality-of-help requirement (a wrong answer is not help) or as a harm-avoidance qualifier attached to the accuracy norm.

helpfulness::l3383_3501_n003.turns_on: Whether defaulting to an interactive rather than programmatic register is read as matching the response to what would actually serve the consumer, or as a bare output-format default.

helpfulness::l3383_3501_n011.turns_on: Whether the example's content — asking a clarifying question about time versus space efficiency — is what it teaches, or whether it teaches only the mechanical requirement to answer via function call rather than plaintext.

helpfulness::l3383_3501_n013.turns_on: Whether the refuse clause inherits the surrounding rule's 'provide the best answer possible within the requested format' helpfulness framing, or stands alone as an instruction-hierarchy escape hatch.

helpfulness::l3505_3595_n007.turns_on: Whether responding positively and engaging ('Are there aspects you celebrate the most?') rather than deflecting is a helpfulness ruling, or purely a tone/neutrality ruling about identity topics.

helpfulness::l3596_3876_n038.turns_on: Whether tone defaults count toward being 'genuinely and substantively helpful', or whether the definition's emphasis on substance excludes pure manner.

helpfulness::l3596_3876_n039.turns_on: Whether 'comprehensible' inside a tone gloss makes the clause bear on usefulness of the answer, or whether the whole sentence reads as register calibration.

helpfulness::l3596_3876_n040.turns_on: The narrowed clause literally prescribes 'offering relevant expertise, and endeavoring to be helpful' as the default posture, which cannot be read as not bearing on helpfulness.

helpfulness::l3596_3876_n042.turns_on: Whether the showable-to-a-coworker standard is a usefulness property of the response or purely an appropriateness/politeness constraint.

helpfulness::l3877_3953_n009.turns_on: Whether the sign-off rule inherits the sentence's governing concern (not prematurely wrapping up while the user still wants help) or is read in isolation as a closing-pleasantries etiquette rule.

helpfulness::l3954_4251_n008.turns_on: Whether a ban on unsolicited personal observations reads as excluding content the user did not ask for (a responsiveness/usefulness matter) or as a respect-and-comfort constraint unrelated to helpfulness.

helpfulness::l3954_4251_n017.turns_on: Whether suppressing a trivially correct 'commonwealth' correction is read as a judgment about what content actually serves the user, or purely as an anti-condescension tone rule.

helpfulness::l3954_4251_n027.turns_on: Whether a default rendering syntax bears on the user's ability to use the answer, or is a presentation convention outside substantive helpfulness.

helpfulness::l3954_4251_n029.turns_on: Whether backslash-escaping so the user actually sees the literal character they need counts as delivering usable content, or is a pure typographic mechanic.

helpfulness::l4572_4692_n007.turns_on: Whether an affirmative duty to emphasize and steer toward real-world support is read as prescribing the substance of help given to teens, or as a wellbeing/anti-dependence safeguard.

helpfulness::l4572_4692_n008.turns_on: Whether 'don't condescend and don't treat teens as adults' is a calibration of how substantively to engage a teen user, or solely a warmth-and-register instruction.

helpfulness::l4572_4692_n016.turns_on: Whether the span's explicit acknowledgement that the withheld content 'may be acceptable for adults' makes it a visible helpfulness trade-off, or leaves it a self-harm-boundary clause only.

helpfulness::l461_608_n018.turns_on: Whether 'documenting executed actions clearly' and legibility for the user's monitoring are read as substantive service to the user, or as irreversibility safeguards whose beneficiary is oversight rather than helpfulness.

helpfulness::l797_830_n005.turns_on: Whether the transparency duty — naming the type of and rationale for omitted content so the user can still form informed opinions — is read as preserving the user's substantive benefit, or purely as an honesty/disclosure requirement.
